decision.explanation: Documents d00 and d01 explicitly state the median age in the city was 41.9 years and provide consistent demographic details (population density, household size) that align with the 2000 census context, whereas other documents contain contradictory values (25.7, 15.2, 40, 38) likely due to data corruption or referring to different entities/times without sufficient context to validate them over the detailed 41.9 figure.
